- 一并修复非 openai 自定义提供商的模型抓取功能

#### 📝 Additional Information


- close #6964
- close #8086


<!-- Add any other context about the Pull Request here. -->

## Summary by Sourcery

Refactor client model runtime initialization to accept explicit options and introduce runtimeProvider resolution for custom providers, and update chat and models services to use this mapping for client-side fetch, fixing failures when custom providers are enabled.

Bug Fixes:
- Fix custom provider failures by using runtimeProvider when fetching models and chat completions on the client

Enhancements:
- Refactor initializeWithClientStore to accept an options object with provider, payload, and runtimeProvider parameters
- Introduce resolveRuntimeProvider helper to map custom provider identifiers to actual SDK runtime keys
- Propagate runtimeProvider through createPayloadWithKeyVaults and server-side initModelRuntimeWithUserPayload

Tests:
- Update and add unit tests for clientModelRuntime, ModelsService, and server initModelRuntimeWithUserPayload to cover runtimeProvider logic and endpoint mapping
